name: r113_heat_pump_second_law
title: Second-law efficiency of an R113 heat pump (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise for an R113 heat pump. The model computes the real COP, the Carnot COP between the condenser and evaporator saturation temperatures, and the second-law efficiency.

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of Q1_rendement_II_principe.EES, compare_solution.py --ees-units reports: 15 common variables, 9 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 16. The maximum it prints is 9.15e-01 on T1 (stored kelvin rewritten to °C). COP_reel 3.33573 against 3.32517, COP_carnot 5.79692 against 5.81875, n_II_principe 57.5432 against 57.1458. All 31 equations are satisfied.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in Q1_rendement_II_principe.EES (15 variables, EES X6.883), compared with compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: Largest relative difference printed by compare_solution.py --ees-units is 9.15e-01 on T1 (unrounded 0.91549). The tool converts a stored value whose unit is K and whose name starts with T from kelvin to °C. It rewrote T1 and T_cond only. T2 and T3 have a blank stored unit, so they stay in kelvin and print 3.65e-04 and 4.11e-04. In kelvin, T1 is 298.245733 K against 298.354535 K (3.65e-04) and T_cond is 360.420202 K against 360.269879 K (4.17e-04). T3 - T_cond is 5, as written. Pressures print 0. The 16 names only in CoolSolve are the diagram arrays P[i], h[i], T[i], s[i]. Absolute enthalpies differ by about 166.1 kJ/kg: h1 and h4 by 166094.71 J/kg, h2 by 166116.30 J/kg, h3 by 165934.32 J/kg. Those offsets do not cancel. h3-h2 is 42108.55 J/kg against 42290.53 J/kg, and h3-h4 is 140462.88 J/kg against 140623.26 J/kg. COP_reel therefore prints 3.17e-03, COP_carnot 3.75e-03 (saturation temperatures) and n_II_principe 6.91e-03. Every equation residual is 0. 0 iterations with .initials and 0 without. The extractor warning that stored values equal the guesses is recorded in the README; the stored COPs match the stored enthalpies and temperatures. R113 was accepted. No fluid-name warning was printed.
